song.author: Michael W. Smith, Michael Farron
song.title: Let it rain
song.lyrics:
[V1] . Em. C Let it rain, let it rain. . G. D Open the floodgates of Heaven.
[V2] .Em We feel the rains of Your Love, .C We feel the winds of Your Spirit, . G And now the heartbeat of Heaven, . D Let us hear.
[V3] Because we want to see You; Show us Your Glory. And we want to know You, Lord.
